title: The Fast and the Furious — Family first

hook.quote: I live my life a quarter mile at a time.
hook.context: Dom poyga paytida hayotni qanday his qilishini tushuntiradi: chorak mil (~400 metr) davom etadigan o'sha bir necha soniyada u to'liq erkin. Keyingi ertangi kun haqida o'ylamaydi. "at a time" — "har safar ... dan" degan ibora.

reading: Brian O'Conner is an undercover police officer in Los Angeles. Trucks full of expensive electronics have been stolen on the highway, and the police think street racers are responsible.
Brian pretends to be a racer and tries to get close to Dominic Toretto, a legend of illegal street racing. Dom is tough, but for him nothing is more important than family.
In his first race Brian bets his car and loses. He should have been more careful, but he wanted to impress Dom and his sister Mia.
Slowly Brian becomes part of Dom's team. They eat together, work on cars together and protect each other. Brian starts to feel that this is his real family.
At the same time he discovers that Dom's team really is behind the robberies. He should have told his boss immediately, but he doesn't.
During the last robbery, the truck driver fights back, and Dom's friend Vince is badly hurt. Brian reveals that he is a police officer to call a helicopter and save Vince's life.
At the end, Brian lets Dom go. He could have arrested him, but he chooses loyalty over the law. The decision changes his life forever.

grammar.title: should have / could have / shouldn't have + V3
explain: **should have + V3** — o'tmishda qilish kerak edi, lekin qilinmadi (afsus, tanqid): Brian **should have told** his boss (lekin aytmadi).
**shouldn't have + V3** — qilinmasligi kerak edi, lekin qilindi: He **shouldn't have bet** his car (lekin tikdi va yutqazdi).
**could have + V3** — imkoniyat bor edi, lekin ishlatilmadi: He **could have arrested** Dom, but he let him go.
Og'zaki nutqda qisqaradi: should've /ˈʃʊd.əv/, could've /ˈkʊd.əv/. Yozuvda "should of" — keng tarqalgan XATO, to'g'risi **should have**.

exercises.q: Brian ___ told his boss immediately, but he didn't.
exercises.why: O'tmishda qilinmagan to'g'ri ish → should have + V3.
